brief:
- Complexity level 1: keep a broad and explicit task description.
- Record scope boundaries, dependencies, and expected outputs in concrete terms.
- Prefer splitting meaningful follow-up work into child nodes instead of hiding it in prose.
execute:
- Use phased execution with explicit checkpoints.
- Review whether this node should delegate work to child nodes before expanding local scope.
- Reassess complexity after structural changes, new children, or additional dependencies.
validate:
- Validate parent-child boundaries and resume quality.
- Confirm the node still deserves level 1 detail after current changes.
- Add broader acceptance checks when the node coordinates multiple surfaces.
roadmap:
## Managed complexity guidance

- Use a multi-phase roadmap with explicit checkpoints.
- Reassess whether scope should be split into child nodes.
- Keep roadmap text detailed enough for coordination-heavy work.
